title: journalctl — Print log entries from the systemd journal
versionOrDate: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Noble systemd 255 manual; reviewed 2026-08-02
relevance: Official Ubuntu 24.04 rendering of the systemd journalctl manual for querying by boot, unit, priority, time and structured fields. It supports reproducible local evidence collection while preserving the boundary that an empty query may reflect scope, permissions, retention or filtering and is not proof that no event occurred.
